shortDescription: Manage static IP routes on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: admin_distance
options.description: Admin distance of the static route. Range is 1 to 255.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:False), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: mask
options.description: Network prefix mask of the static route.

options.name: next_hop
options.description: Next hop IP of the static route.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Specifies the destination IPv4 address. provide prefix in the format either A.B.C.D or A.B.C.D/L (where "L" is the prefix-length of the mask). if A.B.C.D/L format is used, do not specify mask.

options.name: purge
options.description: Purge routes not defined in the I(aggregate) parameter.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the static route configuration.
